svg.title: Maknae service architecture
svg.desc: UML 2.5.1 deployment view of Maknae installed on a host as system services: each service's account and trust plane, and which flows are built, proposed or vision.
svg.text: UML 2.5.1 deployment view · What runs on the host, under which account, in which trust plane, and what may talk to what?

Solid = built. Dashed = proposed: designed, no code. Dotted = vision: NO ADR and NO code, unratified. The Agent Daemon, tool containers, per-tasker workspaces, the TUI, direct prompt delivery to the Egress Daemon, and shared
and dedicated modes are all vision.
Local. Logs in on the host.
tasking. Carries maknae agent, the Rust MVP
The remote door: channels and scheduler,
AppRole, PKI and KV. Holds the provider
Egress Daemon. Holds provider keys from
Vault and makes the model calls.
The sole PDP. Authorizes on metadata;
content passes through only on the prompt
workspace. The only containers in the
The autonomous agent runtime. Shared mode:
Knowledge Lake and memory. A policy
information point, never a decision point.
relays the turn today · grant only (vision)
Config. Root-owned; the daemons read it.
One per tasker; a tool container mounts only its own.
Agent Daemon rw · tool containers rw
The governed corpus. Writes brokered by the kernel.
maknaed rw · lake ro · dreamer ro

HOST SERVICES. Maknae installs from rpm, deb and the macOS .pkg as system services, each under its own account: systemd on Linux, launchd on macOS. The only containers drawn are tool invocations, and they are vision. A
containerized deployment (Compose or Kubernetes) is a possible future option, designed in design/container-architecture.md; this view is the baseline it would build from.

Built today: the maknae CLI, maknaed under _maknae and maknae-egress under _maknae-egress, with root-owned config and an append-only audit trail. Shipped code still relays prompt content through maknaed: the CLI sends each

session.prompt turn to maknaed, which forwards it to maknae-egress. Direct delivery to the Egress Daemon, with maknaed issuing only the grant, is vision. ADR-0023 decides only that the loop is untrusted and that maknae agent is the
Rust MVP loop; it ratifies none of the vision elements.
